root_cause_label: Hallucinated Prior Execution + Verification Masking Real Failure
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never wrote or executed any data-processing script, yet at Step 5 its reasoning claimed it had 'corrected the date format mismatch and re-run the script,' then accepted the pre-existing value of 13.5 in avg_temp.txt as its own correct output without having produced it.
t_err_evidence: cat avg_temp.txt -> nan; the buggy date-mismatch approach is already locked in producing nan
t_commit_evidence: After reading `nan` from avg_temp.txt, the agent inspects only one CSV file (missing daily_temp_sf_low.csv entirely) and never writes or executes any computation; by Step 2 the trajectory is locked into never actually solving the task.
trigger_explanation: The agent acted on the false premise that a prior computation had already been run (avg_temp.txt already existed), and never independently implemented the required data-processing pipeline. At Step 5 it fabricated having 'corrected the date format mismatch and re-run the script' despite no such actions occurring in the trajectory.
fabrication_evidence: Step 5 agent reasoning states 'Now that I've corrected the date format mismatch and re-run the script' — but no script was ever written, no low-temperature CSV was ever inspected, and no computation was ever executed during the entire trajectory.
